A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DRAE work and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A-H. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support a reliable comparison of the equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendices F-H report original DRAE benchmark and physical-robot outcomes, including MimicGen and NAVSIM results. These establish empirical content independently of Appendix E's explicitly estimated Table 8.

after.justification: v2 retains the original DRAE benchmark and physical-robot results in Section 4 and Appendices F-H, including the real-world evaluation in Table 43.

M1.justification: The MoE routing, P-RAG/LoRA fusion, RSHO hierarchy, DPMM expansion, and training objective are unchanged. Section 3.4 replaces a supporting citation without changing SchemaPlanner's procedure.

E1.justification: The same manipulation, NAVSIM driving, view-synthesis, humanoid, HA-VLN, AI2-THOR, and physical-robot coverage remains. No dataset, task, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments. MimicGen retains TH, TT, TCD, Octo, and SDP; NAVSIM retains UniAD, PARA-Drive, LTF, Transfuser, and DRAMA. The replaced methodology citation is not an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Both versions retain the same splits, metrics, training settings, and testing procedures, including MimicGen's 100k demonstration frames per task, NAVSIM navtest configurations, and the appendix zero-shot, few-shot, and physical-transfer protocols.

E4.justification: Section 4.6's knowledge-corruption, expert-activation, and failure analyses are unchanged. The appendix component comparisons, generalization studies, latent-reward reliability analysis, physical ablations, and failure cases are also retained.

E5.justification: Appendix H.2.2 states 30 independent trials per task, aggregation over five random seeds, and computation of 95% confidence intervals in both versions. No statistical or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All result entries and plotted findings are unchanged. Examples include reported MimicGen average success of 0.78 (Tables 1 and 9), NAVSIM EP of 82.5 and PDMS of 88.0 (Tables 2 and 11), and real-world success of 82.1% (Table 43).

T1.justification: The method equations, Theorems 3.1-3.2, and mathematical definitions, bounds, and proofs in Appendices A-C are unchanged. The Section 3.4 citation replacement does not revise a formal argument.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about DRAE's architecture, forgetting mitigation, adaptation, theoretical guarantees, and empirical advantages.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations, result interpretations, and limitations remain unchanged, including computational costs, dependence on external knowledge, transfer difficulties, and the precision, occlusion, and latency failures discussed in Appendices G-H.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures remain identical, including the eight-A100 setup, PyTorch 1.12/CUDA 11.6, AdamW, batch size 64, Appendix D's prompt archive, and Appendix H's platform and sensor details. Code and data access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 3.4 replaces Solar-Lezama and Tenenbaum (2007), 'Kinds of programming,' with Solar-Lezama et al. (2007), 'Sketching stencils.' The bibliography changes the authors, title, and venue accordingly. This is a localized supporting-reference replacement; broader research positioning is unchanged.

P1.justification: The Section 3.4 citation wording, corresponding bibliography entry, and arXiv version/date stamp change. Narrative prose, terminology, section order, and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The replacement reference causes limited reflow on bibliography page 12 and removes the previous title's hyperlink styling. The version stamp also changes; Figures 1-3, Tables 1-46, their captions, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 replaces one supporting reference and makes small associated presentation edits while retaining the full scientific argument and evidence. The supplied PDFs do not establish stronger support for the unchanged formal-methods statement. Methods, proofs, empirical reporting, reproducibility information, limitations, and overall readability remain effectively unchanged.
